# nodejs

Node.js's license (`LICENSE`, the MIT notices at the top of Node v22.22.2's `LICENSE`), for the
runtime's code ported from Node.js. Nothing here is compiled; the ported code is in `runtime/src`:

- `inspect.c`: `util.inspect` and `util.format`, from `lib/internal/util/inspect.js`.
- `console.c`: `console.table`, from `lib/internal/cli_table.js`.
